title: Averaged NAND parity identity
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite nonempty set, and let $F,P:A\to\mathbb R$ satisfy $|A|^{-1}\sum_{a\in A}P(a)=0$. Then
\[
\frac{1}{|A|^2}\sum_{a,b\in A}\frac{-1-F(a)-F(b)+F(a)F(b)}{2}P(a)P(b)
=\frac12\left(\frac1{|A|}\sum_{a\in A}F(a)P(a)\right)^2.
\]
hypotheses_covered: the average of $P$ over $A$ is zero
